scope: Current consumer fixture ownership. Qualification belongs to source-bound evidence in the shared-tooling review and handoff, not this assertion map.

delivery_policy.owner: Shared Tooling owns batch setup, dispatch, Git delivery, recovery, reconciliation and retirement. Backup supplies package metadata, qualification and exact original-source resume receipts.

frozen_consumer_fixture.scope: Actual Backup workspace, Make/setup/metadata/receipt/native/archive hooks and local Git remotes; only registry upload and one lost commit reply are substituted.
frozen_consumer_fixture.owners: Single coordinated group, deferred lock custody, exact offline recovery, uncertain publication, completed replay, explicit reconciliation/retirement. Shared owns generic group-order/lifecycle matrices; this fixture does not copy them.

historical_receipt_fixture.selection: The fixture explicitly clears RELEASE_GROUP and RELEASE_GROUPS to exercise historical ungrouped adapter contracts. It does not select the default production delivery policy.

assertion_owners.test_dependency_bootstrap: Actual Make dependency gate/cache and failure-log admission
assertion_owners.test_nested_dependency_bootstrap: Actual nested consumer logger checkout/evidence routing
assertion_owners.test_validation_source_identity: Consumer v1 validation sidecar binds original source/selection; false identity rejected
assertion_owners.test_versions: Actual relative consumer entry point resolves under inherited CDPATH; version admission rejects noncanonical/beta/historical regressions; shared helper dispatch retained
assertion_owners.test_invalid_changelog: Consumer candidate/history conflict refusal with exact original bytes
assertion_owners.test_shared_changelog: Consumer delegate finalizer failure/empty output custody and metadata transaction
assertion_owners.test_version_reader: Passive metadata parsing, selected historical package/member input and complete preparation of commented versions with the exact local lock update and unchanged member/foreign lock bytes; no partial helper outputs
assertion_owners.test_multi_package_preparation: Shared renderer integration for owned inline/table/aliased dependency requirements, comments and Unicode checkout paths; canonical operator/precision behavior, exact receipts, member custody and unchanged foreign lock selections
assertion_owners.test_preparation: Actual preparation receipt, original validation sidecar, unchanged foreign lock entries/history and retained backups/cache
assertion_owners.test_lockfile_rejection: Consumer package lock selection/missing/duplicate and failing/empty manifest or lock helper output refuse before replacement
assertion_owners.test_rejected_preparation: Actual product metadata/gate/original-source/fmt refusal and retained inputs/cache
assertion_owners.test_staging: Actual public Make selection refusal and retired local command boundary; no fixture effects
assertion_owners.test_publish: Actual publication Make entry point, fixed roster/registry and exact shared intent/arguments/statuses with or without a release tag; unchanged local metadata and cache
assertion_owners.test_publish_failure: Failed Cargo dry run retains the original Cargo status/log and releases completed locks without metadata mutation
assertion_owners.test_invalid_release: Actual tag-check adapter admits exact receipt/notes/current source and refuses drift
assertion_owners.test_validation_custody: Missing original validation or changed member metadata prevents adapter recovery
assertion_owners.test_early_plan_retry: Fresh normal release supersedes the same candidate plan without parsing it; Backup retains earlier validation bytes before recording fresh proof.
assertion_owners.test_older_release_recovery: Explicit resume checks exact older committed receipts; fresh patch/minor attempts leave the old plan, proof and uncertain delivery untouched. Failed fresh gates retain original evidence.
assertion_owners.test_older_release_padded_count: The same fresh-patch recovery retains exactly two actual push records when wc pads its line count, matching macOS presentation; both normal and focused recovery suites select this regression.
assertion_owners.test_selected_proof_rejection: Explicit resume refuses missing/wrong original receipt identity or unavailable remote proof without dispatching effects.
assertion_owners.test_completed_evidence_replay: Local completed replay requires retained validation; malformed selected-commit/read/write arguments refuse without effects
assertion_owners.test_dependency_failure_conditional_stat: Cargo substitute cannot produce false-success/cache under conditional errexit semantics
assertion_owners.test_conditional_substitute_rejections: Fixture Git/formatter missing proofs cannot become false-success under supported shell semantics
assertion_owners.test_real_index_boundaries: Real private Git index distinguishes staged, unstaged, untracked and unusual-name paths, initial phase refusals and observation errors; preserves index, lock, working bytes and HEAD without creating commits
assertion_owners.test_committed_preparation_retry: Actual Backup Make/metadata adapter starts fresh from unchanged or manually bumped committed metadata; failed gates preserve original validation and metadata backups, and other candidate plans remain unchanged.
assertion_owners.test_clippy_gate: Actual release-verify/CI target roster and Clippy recipe, with preparation/downstream effects substituted; serial/parallel success and failure prove early ordering, unchanged lint scope and no later work/publication after refusal. Publication exclusion and metadata/cache custody remain checked.
assertion_owners.test_selected_tool_preflight: Actual Backup aggregate orders common host/Cargo, locked fetch, Testkit and editor without optional IC installer fixtures; retry, offline/network refusal, invalid CLI, selected lock and required common/prerequisite failures retain original source, tools and evidence. Selected Build/Testkit substitutes require the explicit cli feature.
assertion_owners.test_prepared_explicit_resume: One actual Make-to-adapter lost-commit recovery: exact receipt/validation, frozen metadata/history, completed original candidate and cache custody
assertion_owners.test_publication_admission: Actual local publication caller refuses metadata/eligibility/source/outer-lock/unsupported-option failures without Cargo dispatch
assertion_owners.test_publication_options: Inherited shared adapter settings cannot widen the legacy publication roster, registry, features, verification or dirty-source options
assertion_owners.test_publication_already_published: Cargo already-published refusal remains one exact full-roster attempt; no lookup inference, skipping or automatic retry
assertion_owners.test_publication_interruption: Actual shared runner interrupted after simulated registry effects retains its dispatch evidence/lock and blocks redispatch after the outer lock releases; explicit fixture operator reconciliation archives the stopped lock before a fresh dry run, preserving original evidence

historical_receipt_fixture.git_substitute: Required by actual selected historical receipts: immutable full product trees, source/member/lock/notes/receipt reads, descendant proofs and remote tag association. Generic phase and Git-effect matrices remain upstream; explicit local recovery and fresh attempts retain separate assertions.

shared_fixture_owner: Generic increment, phase, restart, lost-reply and destination matrices remain upstream. Consumer fixtures exercise actual Backup adapters; they do not run the generic suite.

historical_review.scope: The original review retains retired-case mappings, exact fixture/shared hashes, Shared Tooling 0.26.20 qualification, direct-delivery policy and original evidence paths. Its formerly current fields describe that historical review only.
historical_review.custody: No original fixture logs, receipts, Git state or recovery evidence are moved or deleted.
